notes.title: Update 0.99 - release date
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41559903/4bfb7fc642e522161ecba2450fca70b6281c6ac1.jpg
Hello everyone! 

AMNESIA v0.99a has been finished!

Steam release date: 15 July

This time the focus was on Elena and Kate. They both have interesting new events that let you see some hot things.  Hopefully, you’ll enjoy this update as much as the girls enjoyed your attention.

Thank you all for your support. 
Stay tuned!

notes.title: Hiring an artist
notes.content:
Have you ever considered a career in Game-dev? If yes, we have a unique offer for you. We require an artist (3D-artist) to join our team.

Requirements:


 Knowledge of DAZ 3d
 Relevant portfolio in DAZ and willingness to complete test assignments
 Experience and understanding of the process of creating scenes on the given facets
 Experience in Russian-speaking team / knowledge of the Russian language
 Understanding of visual storytelling
 Good artistic taste
 Ability to explain and articulate your concepts, ideas, and solutions
 Full time
 Attention to detail, great interest in your work
 Ability to work comfortably in a team and meet deadlines



What we offer:


 Work in a remote format
 Decent pay
 Access to training materials
 Professional development, we will be happy to support you
 Informal work environment with minimum bureaucracy
 Friendly team of like-minded people


 If you have relevant experience and a strong desire to work in our team, please send your portfolio to amnesia@superalex.pro with the subject DAZ3D Artist.
